name: Sharbat Amla
indication_description: This syrup is indicated in Vitamin C deficiency diseases, cough, cold, general weakness, nervous debility, mental fatigue, weakness of memory, indigestion, malnutrition and leanness.
dosage_description:
Adult: 2-4 teaspoonfuls 1-2 times daily after meal.
Children: 1-2 teaspoonfuls 1-2 times daily after meal. Or, as directed by the registered physician.
contraindications_description: There is no evidence available in contraindication but it may happen in patients who are hypersensitive to any of its ingredient.
side_effects_description: No significant side effects have been observed in therapeutic dosage.
pregnancy_and_lactation_description: The safety of this syrup in pregnancy has not been studied. Therefore, it should be used with caution during pregnancy.
storage_conditions_description: Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool & dry place. Protect from Light.
